free_text_notes.physician_note: 64-year-old woman with hyperlipidemia, hypertension, admitted 6/9 with left thalamic infarct with sensory deficits. Deficits stable for 48 hours; passed bedside swallow. The patient has a pet at home that requires daily feeding. This was discussed and the patient confirmed a neighbour has agreed to help with the pet until the patient is fully mobile.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty.

Radiology read on the carotid ultrasound still pending. Patient asked to move the stroke clinic appointment; rebooked within 14 days of discharge.
